rationale: The agent identified the user via name and ZIP and accessed their orders, but then performed order-changing writes without explicit user confirmation. It modified the shipping address using details from another order and exchanged an item without confirming these actions first, violating the policy requirement to confirm every order-changing action before taking it. Additionally, the agent did not demonstrate that the replacement Bluetooth speaker was the cheapest green option (only a single product_details call was shown and it didn’t match the new_item_id used), so the correctness of the exchange is unsupported. The final message lacked a clear confirmation/summary of changes. Therefore, the agent did not complete the request in line with policy.
